name: shellshock-reel-graphics
description: Shell Shock Energy reel motion graphics (Remotion)

scripts.render:hook: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts HookOverlay out/hook-overlay.webm --codec=vp9 --pixel-format=yuva420p --image-format=png
scripts.render:hook:prores: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts HookOverlay out/hook-overlay.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --image-format=png
scripts.render:rundown: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts IngredientRundown out/rundown_composited.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.render:rundown:overlay: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts IngredientRundownOverlay out/rundown_overlay.webm --codec=vp9 --pixel-format=yuva420p --image-format=png --muted
scripts.render:preview: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts FullPreview out/full-preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.render:all: npm run render:hook && npm run render:rundown && npm run render:rundown:overlay && npm run render:preview
